lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The What Happened Badge
lista.descripcion: The Squirrels try and tell us what has just happened but are struggling to retell the story correctly.

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Telling Time Badge
lista.descripcion: John the Crab needs help planning a surprise party for Nigel. It will only work if everyone is on time with the preparations.

The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle when the Naughty Mice steal their last piece. To get it back, they must take part in a series of puzzles in an underground adventure set by the Puzzle Mouse.

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Action Hero Badge
lista.descripcion: The Squirrels learn about an action hero called Jet Rocket who always saves the day by smashing and crashing things. But there are other ways to save the day.
Duggee struggles to organise the Squirrels in order of height and keeping them focused on the task. Sounds like the Squirrels need some training to improve their concentration.
One and her chums carefully cross the pattern puzzle paths over the magic moats to get to the Pattern Palace. Learn about patterns with the Numberblocks.

lista.titulo: Numberblocks - The Legend of Big Tum
lista.descripcion: A big hairy monster with a big hairy tummy who loves puzzles? Find out who is in Big Tum's tum! Learn how to find missing numbers with the Numberblocks.
One makes a wish that the magic mirror could make lots of friends at once, and pretty soon it's pandemonium. Learn about repeat addition with the Numberblocks.
It was a grey day in the big city. One was wondering where her next case would come from when a square silhouette appeared at the door... Learn how to be a number detective with the Numberblocks.
The Numberblocks make a new friend, football fan Eleven, who gets them all in training for the big match. Learn all about the number 11 with Numberblock Eleven!
Ten and Two make Twelve, who discovers she is a super-rectangle with amazing special powers. Learn all about the number 12 with Numberblock Twelve!
Baby Peg tries to tell Mom she wants a stray kitty for her pet and problem-solving partner.
Pato builds a block tower but when he lends Pocoyo some of his blocks, he takes advantage of it and steals all of Pato’s blocks, angering him.

Pocoyo spots his friends playing with cool toys (Elly plays with a hula-hoop, Baby Bird and Caterpillar fly a kite, and Pato plays with a jump rope) but when he tries go play with them, it doesn’t go very well.
Loula se ha metido en un charco y ahora Pocoyó y Elly tienen que bañarla.
Es la primera vez que Nina celebra Halloween, y nadie consigue contar una historia que la asuste...
Elly bakes a cake for a special occasion, but when Pocoyo and Pato accidentally smush it, they have to help Elly bake another one.

A Honey le toca esperar a que la atienda la doctora Bingo, porque pasan antes otros pacientes con problemas más emocionantes. Bluey, la recepcionista, le dice que tenga paciencia, porque algunos de los casos son un problema gordo.
Como Bluey y Bingo son incapaces de coger un regalo con la garra de la máquina, sus padres crean su propia versión en casa. Sin embargo, su padre no les va a dejar ganar fácilmente.

Cuando Bluey va al mercadillo con los cinco dólares que le ha dejado el ratoncito Pérez, las opciones son infinitas. Sin embargo, cuando recorre los puestos con Indy en busca de la compra perfecta, ve que elegir no es tan fácil.

Bluey, Bingo y sus padres juegan a que sus manos son personajes. Quieren explorar las tierras que hay al otro lado de las Montañas Azules. Las chicas tienen que ser más listas que el zorro caradura para llegar a las camas más blanditas del mundo.

Mientras preparan las cosas de la piscina, Bluey y su padre se burlan de su madre porque les da la lata con lo que tienen que llevar. Sin embargo, cuando llegan ven que les falta de todo y que un poco de planificación da mucho de sí.
A Bluey y a sus amigos les encanta jugar a las tiendas… ¡Si es que consiguen empezar! Como Bluey cuestiona todas las reglas y cambia a los personajes, se pueden estar aquí todo el día.
Oona helps Bernie to impress his lady friend, Bernadette, with a delicious meal.

lista.titulo: Pregunte a los StoryBots - Why Do I Have to Brush My Teeth?
lista.descripcion: To understand why humans need to brush their teeth, the StoryBots travel to a mouth taken over by a gang of bad bacteria. Whoopi Goldberg guest stars.

lista.titulo: Los Octonautas en tierra firme - Salt-Mining Elephants
lista.descripcion: The Octonauts rescue a herd of elephants stuck inside a salt cave.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - A Cranky Goodbye
lista.descripcion: When Bulstrode excitedly announces that he is getting a brand new paint job on the Mainland, everyone is thrilled for him -- except for a crankier-than-usual Cranky. When the crane's dismissive comments upset Bulstrode, the tugboat storms off, leaving Thomas and Percy to pick up the pieces, repair their friendship, and encourage both of them to do something they have never done before -- talk about their true feelings towards each other!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Sameroo
lista.descripcion: Gordon has a day-long assignment for Thomas and the Troublesome Trucks -- they have to transport delivery after delivery to Vicarstown! The Troublesome Trucks are less than enthused -- this "sameroo" job will bore them out of their bolts! The Number One Engine is determined to make the day "amazeroo" for them and does his best to turn their repeated route into a new adventure! After their game of "Switcheroo" gets them lost, Thomas and the Troublesome Trucks learn that routine is not necessarily a bad thing -- in fact, it can be very helpful!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Thomas for a Day
lista.descripcion: When Percy is accidentally doused in blue paint, he gets the opportunity to be Thomas for a day.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - The Super Axle
